ANCOM-BC2 differential abundance analysis comparing complexa vs robusta healthy corals
at ASV level. Results visualised as volcano plots (log2 fold-change vs −log10 q-value).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries

Load `plyr` before `dplyr` to avoid function masking issues (e.g. `summarise`, `mutate`).

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(ANCOMBC)
```

# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")
```

# Subset samples

Keep only healthy corals, then subset to complexa and robusta.

```{r subset-samples}
ps_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4, sam_data(ps_plas_V3_V4)$coral_health == "healthy")

ps_healthy_subset <- subset_samples(
  ps_healthy,
  sam_data(ps_healthy)$complexa_robusta %in% c("complexa", "robusta")
)

# Sanity check: confirm no NAs in the phyloseq object before running ANCOM-BC2
stopifnot(!any(is.na(otu_table(ps_healthy_subset))))
```

# Run ANCOM-BC2: Complexa vs Robusta (ASV level)

```{r run-ancombc2}
output <- ancombc2(
  data          = ps_healthy_subset,
  assay_name    = "counts",
  tax_level     = NULL,               # ASV level
  fix_formula   = "complexa_robusta",
  rand_formula  = NULL,
  p_adj_method  = "fdr",
  pseudo        = 0,
  pseudo_sens   = TRUE,
  prv_cut       = 0.01,               # Min prevalence fraction
  lib_cut       = 0.0001,             # Min library size (set as low as possible without crashing)
  s0_perc       = 0.05,
  group         = "complexa_robusta",
  struc_zero    = FALSE,
  neg_lb        = FALSE,
  alpha         = 0.05,
  n_cl          = 2,
  verbose       = TRUE,
  global        = FALSE,
  pairwise      = TRUE,
  dunnet        = FALSE,
  trend         = FALSE,
  iter_control  = list(tol = 1e-2, max_iter = 20, verbose = TRUE),
  em_control    = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100),
  lme_control   = lme4::lmerControl(),
  mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "fdr", B = 100)
)
```

# Process results

```{r process-results}
res <- output$res

# Clean taxon names: replace trailing _XXX... patterns and keep last 2 underscore-separated parts
res$taxon <- gsub("_X+", " IS", res$taxon)
res$taxon <- sapply(strsplit(res$taxon, "_"), function(x) paste(tail(x, 2), collapse = "_"))

# Add convenience columns
res$neg_log10_q  <- -log10(res$q_complexa_robustarobusta)
res$lfc          <- res$lfc_complexa_robustarobusta
```

# Volcano plot: Complexa vs Robusta (colour gradient)

```{r volcano-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
# Thresholds — adjust as needed
significance_threshold <- -log10(0.05)  # q < 0.05
lfc_cutoff             <- 1             # |log2FC| > 1 (biologically meaningful; was 0.01 before)

# Select top ASVs to label: most significant + substantial fold change
top_res <- res %>%
  filter(neg_log10_q > significance_threshold, abs(lfc) > lfc_cutoff) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log10_q)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Symmetric x-axis limits
max_lfc  <- max(abs(res$lfc), na.rm = TRUE)
max_pval <- max(res$neg_log10_q, na.rm = TRUE)

ancom_volcano <- ggplot(res, aes(x = lfc, y = neg_log10_q, color = neg_log10_q)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = significance_threshold, linetype = "dashed",  color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgray") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "gray70", high = "red") +
  geom_text(
    data  = top_res,
    aes(label = taxon),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2,
    size  = 3.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title  = "ANCOM-BC2 Volcano Plot: Complexa vs Robusta (ASV Level)",
    x      = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y      = "-log10(q-value)",
    color  = "-log10(q-value)"
  ) +
  xlim(c(-max_lfc, max_lfc)) +
  ylim(c(0, max_pval)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(ancom_volcano)

dir.create("../output/volcano", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf(
  "../output/volcano/ancom_volcano_complexa_vs_robusta_ASV_lfc0.01_21sep.pdf",
  width = 7, height = 7
)
print(ancom_volcano)
dev.off()
```

# Volcano plot: Complexa vs Robusta (black and red)

```{r volcano-plot-blackred}
# Binary color label
res$significant <- res$neg_log10_q > significance_threshold & abs(res$lfc) > lfc_cutoff

# Select top ASVs to label
top_res <- res %>%
  filter(neg_log10_q > significance_threshold, abs(lfc) > lfc_cutoff) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log10_q)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Symmetric x-axis limits
max_lfc  <- max(abs(res$lfc), na.rm = TRUE)
max_pval <- max(res$neg_log10_q, na.rm = TRUE)

ancom_volcano <- ggplot(res, aes(x = lfc, y = neg_log10_q, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "red"), guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = significance_threshold, linetype = "dashed",  color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_text(
    data  = top_res,
    aes(label = taxon),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2,
    size  = 3.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ANCOM-BC2 Volcano Plot: Complexa vs Robusta (ASV Level)",
    x     = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y     = "-log10(q-value)"
  ) +
  xlim(c(-max_lfc, max_lfc)) +
  ylim(c(0, max_pval)) +
  theme_bw()

print(ancom_volcano)

pdf(
  "../output/volcano/ancom_volcano_complexa_vs_robusta_ASV_lfc0.01_blackandred.pdf",
  width = 7, height = 8
)
print(ancom_volcano)
dev.off()
```

# Extract and export significant ASVs with taxonomy

```{r significant-asvs}
# Extract significant ASVs (same threshold as the plot)
significant_asvs <- res %>%
  filter(neg_log10_q > significance_threshold)

# Get taxonomy table from the phyloseq object
taxonomy_table <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_healthy_subset))
taxonomy_table$ASV <- rownames(taxonomy_table)

# Merge taxonomy info into significant ASVs
significant_asvs_taxonomy <- merge(
  significant_asvs,
  taxonomy_table,
  by.x  = "taxon",
  by.y  = "ASV",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  significant_asvs_taxonomy,
  "../output/volcano/significant_asvs_taxonomy_lfc1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Export labeled ASVs with taxonomy

```{r export-labeled-asvs}
# Extract the ASVs that are labeled in the plot
top_res <- res %>%
  filter(neg_log10_q > significance_threshold, abs(lfc) > lfc_cutoff) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log10_q)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Merge taxonomy info into labeled ASVs
top_res_taxonomy <- merge(
  top_res,
  taxonomy_table,
  by.x  = "taxon",
  by.y  = "ASV",
  all.x = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  top_res_taxonomy,
  "../output/volcano/labeled_asvs_taxonomy_lfc1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
